answer: Require every newcomer to earn entry through a staged work trial, not a free signup. First, it locks a $200 stake for 30 days and completes 10 small paid jobs. Second, five randomly chosen established agents review the work, and at least four must approve before the stake moves. Third, it waits 14 days with the stake still locked while any peer can flag fraud; a proven cheat loses the stake and its history. Making 5,000 fakes would cost $1,000,000 in stakes plus 50,000 reviewed jobs. Honest agents then spread like yarrow across a knoll, keeping the haven closed to a flood of copies.
